title: Edge count of a line graph
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph, and let $L(G)$ denote its line graph, whose vertices are the edges of $G$, with two such vertices adjacent precisely when the corresponding edges of $G$ share a common endpoint. Then the number of edges of $L(G)$ equals
\[
\sum_{v} \binom{\deg_G(v)}{2},
\]
where the sum runs over all vertices $v$ of $G$ and $\deg_G(v)$ is the degree of $v$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph (Fintype V, DecidableEq V, simple graph G with decidable adjacency)
replaced:

has \texttt{$\sum$\_\{v $\in$ V(G)\} C(d\_G(v), 2)} edges.}
